response.overview: When a young woman discovers her home was built on land contaminated by a secretive program designed to make toxic waste disappear, she embarks on a five-year investigation to uncover one of the most consequential environmental coverups in U.S. history. Through never-before-seen depositions, interviews with insiders, and testimony from some of the most respected scientific minds in the field, the film reveals how this dangerous material was intentionally woven into everyday life across the country, entering where we live, work, and play.
response.title: Sludge War
